text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm walking around town on my day off,
when...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Gah! The hell is with this game?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Give me a break. What happened to
that
confidence you had a minute ago?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's you. Ama dragged me into this.
choice_data_list: Playing against each other? That l...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! This racing game's really popular
at the
dorm...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And Brian likes these kinds of heated

competitions, so I brought her along.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You wanna give it a go? Brian's pretty
good!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...All right. I'll race you,
but you better
put up a
good fight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we start playing the racing
game...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You think you can get away?! I'm gonna
tear you
to shreds!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! Looks like you're slowin'
down! You
losing your focus?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian's speed slows, her assault
pausing for
just a moment. And then...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: A feint?! You passed me!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, hey! What was that technique just now?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Heh.
I guess that trainer title isn't just
for show,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Assess your own abilities and build a
racing style
from there... I approve.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing! Just what exactly did
you even
do?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? So you bet on having a burst of
speed for
that single moment?
choice_data_list: I just made the most of my reflexes.
I'm just taking a quick breather, ...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I see! This ended up being more fun than
I
thought.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Wait. Who said we're finished?
choice_data_list: I had a great time too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh? You wanna keep playing?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Things are finally getting fun. I'm going
to bring
devastating speed to the next
race and tear right
through you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian's focus on speed ends up
bringing
undeniable results. It seems
today has been a
good change of pace!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Conserving your energy while also luring your prey into complacency...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wow! I guess there are things in games
you can
apply to real races.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. I feel like we can really get our
blood
pumping.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Amazon, we're heading back to the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong? You so fired up that the
game isn't
enough anymore?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If it's a challenge you want,
I accept! But
things
won't go as smoothly as the game
for you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... If there's no challenge, it's not
worth
doing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the partner running that follows, it
appears Narita Brian has already
managed to add the new
insights to her
arsenal.
